dedupe_keys.name: freightos baltic index fbx global container freight rate index

description: The Freightos Baltic Index (FBX) is an international ocean freight index of the price of 40-foot containers across the major global shipping lanes, created by Freightos in collaboration with the Baltic Exchange. The index page states that FBX is the only IOSCO-compliant container freight index, used for index-linked contracts and derivatives and traded on the Singapore Exchange and the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, and that its rates are aggregated from actual carrier transactions, not surveys or estimates. It tracks lanes such as Asia to Europe and Asia to North America, and is offered through Freightos' data terminal with charts. Coverage: main container trade lanes worldwide. Format and access: web charts, with fuller data through the Freightos terminal. Licence and cost: freemium; the headline index is visible, and detailed series are commercial. Caveats: the method and lane weights are proprietary, and the index measures spot prices, not capacity or transit times. Freight rate spikes are a practical signal of disruption, for example from canal closures or port congestion, so the series supports resilience and capacity planning studies of maritime supply chains. It complements the Drewry World Container Index, UNCTADstat maritime statistics in the catalogue.
